notes: Astrobee hardware-specific constraints. Camera resolution and frame rate limits are per camera hardware. Operating limits represent physical actuator maximums.

Science.notes: Science camera (SciCam) on arm. H.264 streaming via RTSP.

Navigation.notes: Navigation camera (NavCam) forward-facing. Used for localization.

Dock.notes: Dock camera (DockCam) aft-facing. Used for AR tag localization during docking.

Hazard.notes: Hazard camera (HazCam) forward-facing depth sensor. Fixed resolution.

Perch.notes: Perch camera (PerchCam) aft-facing depth sensor. Fixed resolution.

operating_limits.notes: Physical actuator maximums. Operational profiles (quiet/nominal/difficult/precision) set limits below these values.

arm.notes: Pan must be 0 when tilt > 90 (arm in payload bay). Gripper must be closed when tilt > 160 (near stowed position).
